column9: Covers "Peat Week" / "Week of Peat" release names.
Peaty Collection / Peated Edition releases, ~20ppm; matches this batch's own sample "AnCnoc Sherry Peated".
Elements Peated Cask edition; smokiness is cask-derived from ex-Islay casks rather than peated malt, but is consistently reviewed and marketed as a peated dram.

Clan Denny Islay blended malt vats Ardbeg, Bowmore, Bruichladdich, Bunnahabhain, Caol Ila and 2 undisclosed Islay distilleries - described as having phenolic/smoked character. Highland and Speyside editions are NOT covered by this rule and fall back to the producer row's own unpeated baseline.

Tourbe = French for peat; distillery site lists a "Peated" expression (URL slug "troube") as a distinct product from "Original". Exact ppm/intensity not confirmed - medium is a conservative estimate, flagged for reviewer.

This batch's own sample includes the product "Kilkerran Heavily Peated" - the name is self-declaring, but no external citation for this specific release's peat level could be opened this session (see the kilkerran producer row's note for why the baseline is left unknown). sourceUrls intentionally empty rather than inventing one; flagged for reviewer.
